Logic lives in world/sources/quests; this file holds only the words. `factIds` are dialogue facts (world/sources/dialogue/facts.json) the words state; `groundedIn` names the place facts claim ids behind the words. Compiled to packages/text-catalogue/src/generated/journal-text.ts by `python3 -m worldgen.place_text --emit-text`.

entries.text: Gnaeus Martius, serjeant of the Broke Column, told me the column's men stand a watch over the Gideon road. I'm to ask the serjeant below the camp which boats the watch counts.
Ask Gnaeus Martius below the camp which boats the watch counts
Gnaeus Martius told me the watch counts the boats by the toll office's own published schedules. The toll office is at Cartwright's Cross. That is my next stop.
Gnaeus Martius is dead. I cannot learn which boats the watch counts now.
